name: OnePA Team
subject: Philadelphia cannot keep dumping its pollution on Black communities
body:
Reworld wants years more of Philadelphia’s trash. The City Council can stop it. | |
---
Peter, **For years, Philadelphia has sent huge amounts of our trash to be burned in Chester, leaving a majority-Black community to live with the pollution while waste management company Reworld profits from the arrangement.** Now Philadelphia is preparing to hand the company another 4-year contract, with the possibility of extending it for 3 more. Under Philadelphia’s last contracts, roughly 40% of our trash was burned, most of it at Reworld’s Chester facility. Research presented to Pennsylvania lawmakers found that **the facility emits more fine-particle pollution than any other trash incinerator in the country** and operates with fewer air-quality controls than its peers. And Reworld has been working hard to protect that arrangement. While Philadelphia officials were debating the future of the city’s trash, Reworld spent more than $100,000 lobbying the City Council and Mayor Parker’s administration. This is what corporate power looks like: money and access flowing into City Hall while Black communities are expected to carry the consequences. **But Reworld does not get the final say. The Philadelphia City Council must approve this contract. When our communities organize together, we can make sure public decisions answer to the people who live with them, not the corporations that can afford armies of lobbyists.** **[Tell the Philadelphia City Council to reject the Reworld contract and stop sending our trash to be burned in Chester.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_-6ezreVUDKM4uYMpG61B3tmZL107ueVKGrZcnb23wpIlNenMRc0EGDKYwCt9bDYoMDJMpGhP2LgFfCXKiSKRlKIdB9gTMnvhuAd1inXxcj4LeoEUydL_3jiA08U5wp77l065WAtucxEPl1jpAR003uqU_rlfg56YJa2HTA1Z2DYSqiffprXGPX-937HPp9gvAl8NAidtJvKcoC37SUAWq5GWSFN8j7M3v9MYPYDOPL5YCacr7aGVr0KLSKjvMBlgJ5oaNfCKFmyYh5iYffsJBWuhFddwJYCi27BoNvclQNZ7Y9dA6G0Ykui00OyzBjDAh8bMFRtod5ZAefXuflj8ajevWjV4RdCXy82bI01xX8sa50Easx2gCUTCnOPp9WFg/4tp/wPaZbZhBQyC_GFFKE52ENg/h0/h001.UefsLTPusBLX94aCz_pxZjev0wK46i_cgVYwZSBt6YM)** | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_-6ezreVUDKM4uYMpG61B3tmZL107ueVKGrZcnb23wpLYdlLiQkASml6ohag1a_ds9UMAowi3DTV9ZnevzaPeqhMbbABW37K1tZsOs3uZDUPTjceZhPAQYq1iwuSB8mZQ2r5i1xjGFVIQMkOBHggL23watG-o-HwcKpWQBzaJUTNgYk1piEKMfyTdx2FASrp8fK4qhZWFNr8-zsi5scdsI2LsOUTpHTKkKFm4dWgsX3tcMjLUJZGzG-3-3kdonzV5SKVB4_Mq7bjf620dTBgcwijtcH04SAj7LPFjFIncezhFJ75pXcB3BkRaq4EHg3PYwNPmnnBP2cGzW1hmszo_06C9F33kLMOaNWfY4THwyTQdHjRjA2f6xlvjLxX6ntjI/4tp/wPaZbZhBQyC_GFFKE52ENg/h1/h001.N2MXYymo7_Qjbm9yjkvKRH0uyPQOoxUSnESUE2zfkAg)
---
**Chester residents have been organizing against pollution in their community for decades. Their fight is part of a much bigger struggle over whose health gets protected, whose neighborhoods get sacrificed, and whose voices have power when government makes decisions that shape our lives.**
Black and working-class communities are told that pollution is simply the cost of doing business. Corporations collect the revenue while families are left breathing the air. That is environmental racism, and organizing is how we change it.
Reworld and its workers have also argued that ending incineration could put jobs at risk. Workers deserve good, stable jobs. Chester families deserve clean air. **A corporation should not get to force our communities to choose between the two while it protects a contract worth tens of millions of dollars.**
We build power by standing together across neighborhoods and demanding more from the people who represent us. The Philadelphia City Council has an opportunity right now to listen to organized communities and stop extending a system that has forced Chester to carry Philadelphia’s pollution for too long.
**[Tell the Philadelphia City Council to reject the Reworld contract and put the health and power of our communities ahead of corporate influence.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_-6ezreVUDKM4uYMpG61B3tmZL107ueVKGrZcnb23wpEckMsAYG5SoT82SMnV1aJ5PeWfejzAyreeCs6fzhufrQOCaAZcPcrEycTcHhAZyrJfVgnYaYQHtydOJmOHxAchtXj-4MHDiQoU9NnA4zOM84bHc8FblQPGAON-ApVbQ5E6AI-vuJmDA0P_cG3Gvi9L-SjILo7d0aJYUqu8Z1i84pVr6RoiEv9y6AycAC3WaKv0xKsdpjciKtLmpK-HZSzf68M2D9deOvn7DtKo5D7KBM3nEppt7jPjssjheuthB4x08H712BoWHEd1EvcZ-pXQTXm2-xv9cWLvqQjay0OkReAeQPPgy9lGguSPUv7NqiC00PA5Y8J_LTp_XA6WkzTs/4tp/wPaZbZhBQyC_GFFKE52ENg/h2/h001.fMPucZsiNA6FxuhKNrYt9pQ7vQgPsWmIzBAbWQanLfU)**

clean_body: Reworld wants years more of Philadelphia’s trash. The City Council can stop it. | | Peter, For years, Philadelphia has sent huge amounts of our trash to be burned in Chester, leaving a majority-Black community to live with the pollution while waste management company Reworld profits from the arrangement. Now Philadelphia is preparing to hand the company another 4-year contract, with the possibility of extending it for 3 more. Under Philadelphia’s last contracts, roughly 40% of our trash was burned, most of it at Reworld’s Chester facility. Research presented to Pennsylvania lawmakers found that the facility emits more fine-particle pollution than any other trash incinerator in the country and operates with fewer air-quality controls than its peers. And Reworld has been working hard to protect that arrangement. While Philadelphia officials were debating the future of the city’s trash, Reworld spent more than $100,000 lobbying the City Council and Mayor Parker’s administration. This is what corporate power looks like: money and access flowing into City Hall while Black communities are expected to carry the consequences. But Reworld does not get the final say. The Philadelphia City Council must approve this contract. When our communities organize together, we can make sure public decisions answer to the people who live with them, not the corporations that can afford armies of lobbyists. | | Chester residents have been organizing against pollution in their community for decades. Their fight is part of a much bigger struggle over whose health gets protected, whose neighborhoods get sacrificed, and whose voices have power when government makes decisions that shape our lives. Black and working-class communities are told that pollution is simply the cost of doing business. Corporations collect the revenue while families are left breathing the air. That is environmental racism, and organizing is how we change it. Reworld and its workers have also argued that ending incineration could put jobs at risk. Workers deserve good, stable jobs. Chester families deserve clean air. A corporation should not get to force our communities to choose between the two while it protects a contract worth tens of millions of dollars. We build power by standing together across neighborhoods and demanding more from the people who represent us. The Philadelphia City Council has an opportunity right now to listen to organized communities and stop extending a system that has forced Chester to carry Philadelphia’s pollution for too long. Together, we can make City Hall answer to our communities. -OnePA | OnePA is a 501(c)4 organization Contributions to OnePA are not tax deductible for federal income tax purposes Our mailing address is P.O. clean_body: A Bible Revival Is Coming to Public Schools Now we're going to get biblical values back into public schools. | | | | Dear Friend, Will you help me put God back in your town schools? Specifically, I'm asking you to sign the "" petition and tell your Governor that the children in your community deserve to hear that: They are wonderfully made in the very image of God. And that God is calling them to love Him above all else. What a country we'd be, if all of America's children had just a little bit of God's Word in their lives - like you did. But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools. Your signature on your "" petition tells our representatives that you want biblical lessons put back in schools. Your signed " " petition is going straight to my friends at BRAVE FOR GOOD. BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group behind my "See You at the Library" movement featured on Fox News, that gets conservative Story Hours into public libraries to counter the Left's "Drag Queen Story Hours." BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group that got an historic conservative Story Hour into the Library of Congress last year! And BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish - and that America was founded upon - back into public schools this year! HOW? We've designed a mini-curriculum for America's 250th Anniversary that teaches children about the role of the Bible in our nation's Founding and emphasizes the Founding values that have made our country great. Last year I got into three public schools to reach 1,400 children with biblical lessons. That's why BRAVE FOR GOOD is getting ready for the battle by collecting stacks of petitions. Your signed " " petition tells our representatives that the Supreme Court ruling that took the Bible out of schools only specified that the Bible could not be mandatory reading. The 1963 ruling 100% allows for the Bible to be taught in a historical or cultural context! And why wouldn’t it be? In every corner of the world, the Bible is considered one of the greatest books ever written. Of course children should learn about it in your taxpayer-funded schools! But radical educators will try to keep anything to do with the Bible out of our schools and when they do, BRAVE FOR GOOD will be ready to counter them with thousands of signed petitions. Every petition you send digitally must still be delivered, verified, securely collected, and tabulated before it can be presented - and That means your gift today puts hundreds of new voices on the record before the deadline. Together with BRAVE FOR GOOD and patriots like you, we got conservative and patriotic values back into public libraries. Now we're going to get biblical values back into public schools. Only God can lead our nation back to His Word. But you and I are called to do our part too. Thank you for standing with us. May God bless you, | | | Kirk Cameron BRAVE For Good | | | | | | | | | P.S. Our best chance to put the biblical values our nation was founded upon back into schools is this year during America's 250th Anniversary so please hurry. | | | BRAVE FOR GOOD is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: New Poll: Is NM’s Governor Race Suddenly Competitive?
body:
Hull closes the gap, NM has billions but could lose population, ICE arrests surge — plus our tribute to Dolly. | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/dL8A69beiJW?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
New Poll: Is NM’s Governor Race Suddenly Competitive?
A new poll just turned New Mexico’s governor race into something worth watching VERY closely. Greg Hull is now just six points behind Deb Haaland in the latest Albuquerque Journal poll — despite an enormous fundraising disadvantage and a general election campaign that has been remarkably quiet so far.
And that’s only where today’s show starts.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/MbwdUmqkBBk?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |

🔥 IS THE GOVERNOR’S RACE SUDDENLY REAL?
The new Journal poll has Haaland at 49% and Hull at 43%, with 8% of voters still undecided.That alone is interesting.But dig into the numbers and it gets even more interesting:• 19% of independents remain undecided
• Hull leads among men by 6 points
• Haaland leads among women by 17
• Hull has a 10-point advantage among voters with a high school/trade-school education
• Haaland has raised roughly $14 million while Hull has been hovering around the $1 million mark
That last number is remarkable.
How does a candidate with that kind of financial advantage find herself only six points ahead?
We break down where Hull still needs to grow, where Haaland remains strong, and the BIG question now: Does this poll convince national Republican groups that New Mexico is worth investing in?
Spoiler alert: The next two weeks could tell us a lot.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/2qJcN3GTeNy?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |

💰 NEW MEXICO HAS BILLIONS — BUT WE’RE LOSING PEOPLE?
Here’s a combination of numbers that should get every New Mexican’s attention.New Mexico is projected to bring in $14.8 BILLION in general fund revenue in FY2028, including roughly $924 million in “new money” available to lawmakers.Personal and corporate income-tax projections alone were revised upward by $380 million for FY2027.
Yet another projection shows New Mexico becoming one of only TWO states west of the Mississippi expected to lose population through 2040.
Meanwhile:Texas: +20%
Utah: +21%
Arizona: +14%
Colorado: +12%
New Mexico: roughly -2%
How does a state with our resources, weather, culture and extraordinary natural beauty end up on the shrinking side of that map?
We break down what we believe New Mexico is missing — and why economic growth has to become a much bigger priority for our leaders.

🚨 ICE ARRESTS ARE SURGING
Trump campaigned on dramatically increasing immigration enforcement.Now we’re seeing the numbers. ICE arrests topped 43,000 in June and approached 50,000 in July — more than 1,500 arrests per day and getting closer to the administration’s stated goal of 2,000 per day.
Scott Jennings made a simple point on CNN: For millions of Trump voters, this is exactly what they voted for.
We discuss whether immigration will still move persuadable voters in the midterms — or whether most Americans have already picked a side on this issue.

🇻🇪 DID TRUMP JUST PULL OFF A HUGE VENEZUELA DEAL?This story has been overshadowed by everything happening in Iran, but it could have enormous long-term consequences.
The Trump administration has been negotiating a plan that could give the United States a direct financial stake tied to some of Venezuela’s massive proven oil reserves.
There’s a part of this Mark DOESN’T like: government ownership or stakes in private businesses. But strategically? Reducing China’s influence while increasing American access to one of the world’s largest oil reserves could be a very big deal.
We break down both sides.
🌶️ AND THEN THERE’S... GREEN CHILE.Only in New Mexico.
Police say an argument that began over green chile enchiladas escalated into a fight and ultimately a tragic death in Albuquerque.
We read the details and immediately came to the same conclusion:There HAS to be more to this story.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/_u0NcPqz2_Y?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |

🤢 ELLA FACT-CHECKS GEN ZIs “pheromone maxing” actually a thing?
Reports claim young men are skipping deodorant and showers — and doing things we won’t even repeat here 😳 — because they believe their “natural musk” will make them more attractive. So naturally, we brought in our resident Gen Z representative.
Ella’s verdict?She’s calling fake news on this one. 😂
❤️ AND FINALLY, DOLLY.This one was personal for Krysty. Her mom introduced her to Dolly Parton through songs like “Coat of Many Colors,” and Dolly remained one of those special connections between them.
We share a beautiful clip of Dolly talking about growing up in church, loving Jesus, praying before making decisions and asking God to guide her life.Her words about her mission really say it all: glorify God and uplift people.It’s a sweet way to remember a remarkable woman and the faith that grounded her.
And because it’s Sunday, we finish with Game Day — except this time one of our wildlife cameras caught a BLACK BEAR running across our driveway... in Albuquerque!
Never a dull moment around here.

We discuss whether immigration will still move persuadable voters in the midterms — or whether most Americans have already picked a side on this issue. 🇻🇪 DID TRUMP JUST PULL OFF A HUGE VENEZUELA DEAL?This story has been overshadowed by everything happening in Iran, but it could have enormous long-term consequences. The Trump administration has been negotiating a plan that could give the United States a direct financial stake tied to some of Venezuela’s massive proven oil reserves. There’s a part of this Mark DOESN’T like: government ownership or stakes in private businesses. But strategically? Reducing China’s influence while increasing American access to one of the world’s largest oil reserves could be a very big deal. We break down both sides. 🌶️ AND THEN THERE’S... GREEN CHILE.Only in New Mexico. Police say an argument that began over green chile enchiladas escalated into a fight and ultimately a tragic death in Albuquerque. We read the details and immediately came to the same conclusion:There HAS to be more to this story. | | | 🤢 ELLA FACT-CHECKS GEN ZIs “pheromone maxing” actually a thing? Reports claim young men are skipping deodorant and showers — and doing things we won’t even repeat here 😳 — because they believe their “natural musk” will make them more attractive. So naturally, we brought in our resident Gen Z representative. Ella’s verdict?She’s calling fake news on this one. 😂 ❤️ AND FINALLY, DOLLY.This one was personal for Krysty. Her mom introduced her to Dolly Parton through songs like “Coat of Many Colors,” and Dolly remained one of those special connections between them. We share a beautiful clip of Dolly talking about growing up in church, loving Jesus, praying before making decisions and asking God to guide her life.Her words about her mission really say it all: glorify God and uplift people.It’s a sweet way to remember a remarkable woman and the faith that grounded her. And because it’s Sunday, we finish with Game Day — except this time one of our wildlife cameras caught a BLACK BEAR running across our driveway... in Albuquerque! I know you've been flooded with fundraising emails from across the country this week. Campaigns are telling you they are falling behind, and that if you don’t chip in $10 right now, Trump will destroy everything. **But here in Wisconsin, the stakes really are that high, and you answered the call. name: Hull for New Mexico
subject: Santa Fe is sitting on $900 million. Here's what they should do with it.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by [Hull for New Mexico](https://us
body:
I have a plan to use it. Career politicians want to spend it.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/kbUWcNs0g1S?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810)
| |
# Eliminate the Income Tax
---
| | | | | | Friend,
New Mexico's own state economists just revised their revenue forecast upward again. This time by **$924 million** in new money flowing into Santa Fe, on top of what was already projected.
---
| [READ THE REPORT](https://us.list-manage.com/ZlbA6J50NZc?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810)
---
| | | | | |
That is not a typo. Nearly a billion dollars, more than the state budgeted for, sitting in state coffers because New Mexico produces more oil and gas than almost anywhere else in the country.
Here's the question nobody in Santa Fe wants to answer honestly: what happens to it?
The career politicians already have their answer: bigger government. More programs. More checks are written to make you feel better in an election year, while the tax code that's pushing businesses and jobs across our border to Texas stays exactly the same.
I have a different idea. Use this windfall as the down payment to start winding down New Mexico's personal income tax, **permanently**. Not a one-time rebate check. Not a press conference. A real, structural start toward making New Mexico competitive with the states around us instead of losing our businesses and jobs to them.
**This means $1,400 +/- annually back in the pockets of a single filer earning $40,000.00/year.**
I'm not just talking about growth. I'm the only candidate in this race who has actually delivered it.
As Mayor of Rio Rancho, I grew the city from about 91,000 residents to nearly 116,000. I didn't inherit a boomtown. I inherited a city that had gone stagnant, with Intel looking for the exit, and I rebuilt its economy from the ground up: recruiting employers like Safelite and championing the Atrisco Solar Project, a $1 Billion investment that has the capacity to power over 110,000 homes and pumps tax revenue straight into Rio Rancho's public schools.
That's not a talking point. That's a track record.
New Mexico has a once-in-a-generation opportunity sitting in the state treasury right now, and I'm the only candidate who has actually done this before and will fight to spend it on real, lasting tax relief instead of another government program.
I need to get this message into every corner of this state before the politicians in Santa Fe find a way to spend that $924 million on themselves. Can you chip in $25, $50, or $100 right now to help me do it?
---

| Late Friday night, **the US Postal Service finalized their plot to restrict mail-in ballots** ahead of the November midterm elections. The new finalized rule enacts Trump's March executive order, _an order federal courts have repeatedly blocked._

## US Hits Iran Again after Tanker Attacks
American forces launched a [new round of strikes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdI4G2xBcuNiGLttuiQweh9k1GNmTRNmvf-LlE14zutKMjubcP7fp5inRfv_tN3Qc87TjqyZkxjL5DQstfiWuVPxec_KlPg4skwLVS7AS1OQXpidOxjfBRUSFukHXXodBG92pvlld6KPV0fpoW5jj4BeYg9HdbLu51xF0Q-7kgQXVAnTKXPoQIdphAbh6Ew0IAxiIc7n8zbTzijG98xPLZclbk9zKfFShfwk1CjXu7yNXPldCjSdYqBHsOVqhxkeVp-EnVS70D6s87WTMRVZc8h4k04aSdsmvLIN_1zPPnjnh54qLJ5Y5yjWX7fFfqLEpLhwvSolqfxUG7pun9P0e_7DVp1NfAQAA___Fk41P) on Iran at noon ET on Tuesday, the second since the weekend, as the battle over the Strait of Hormuz escalated. Hours earlier, Iran struck [two supertankers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDtu8zAQhE9DdRTW1Ltg8Tfq_LcphbW0tDagSIFcm0hOHyhXSDuYB775uC93ZM_h-R8PsuLiEqhkTyKUFjwo8Yo7S-aEIUePKb9OSosB02uYNJgFV-E3LS1Wm3VEhpqK7G0Yx6ZtOtNXux1hWrsbIT2wccPY4QhTBzh12Dz6fnMV26sPJjA3gM60db85cNO4AgzYuhZUC7SxxFR_Rg6yk_Nf8U2pXuNRebuLnFk1_5SZlZlLKfUFEVA4hhDL5br0mPymzPzK-qLRBZPOkpBFR6f3mI7Xt84Y1iuWlZnxOJWZq2S3s7D3nPtBtfA8kP3vsPzxr7c1PwEAAP__WK-CJw) hauling 4 million barrels of Saudi oil near Oman. Tehran had also tried to lay fresh mines in the strait and fired eight missiles at a U.S. base in Jordan. President Trump called the strikes "large and powerful" and [warned on Truth Social](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2K4zAUxfGnsbqEq2t9WIWKhcVdtlqY0lysq1iDbBlJSZi3HzKvMO058Cv-H7flRimn4_6PdvY9luXgV8vcO9eFdq5ppS31liodrWSq7XFyXRDQXMBdABdae3ryokgEH5mRR8Fe2mka1ajRiM0bUDaQnty48hisNGynKCcdQgjG6CCSf3vgACWARnU1IUJ00wpgSUUFgwIOqZd6_Szp6BvH_FWeXK9r2UX2W-9nG8Y_A84Dzr0--tbKmii___eooDLlv-WgHP7Xx34OOJ-l9TbgLKWVzjgNylkLqCWK6sP5SjmnZuyg4L5T-qFE_2Whp8fvAAAA__-R0Hk6) that the biggest attack is still "waiting in the wings" and that afterward "there will be very little left of the Islamic Republic of Iran!" The military command said the strikes are [focused on the Revolutionary Guard](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu8jAQwPGncTbQ5Xw48eDhE_qyQZdKHSMTn4krJ0H2Ae3bV_QVuv6H3_D_OI0nn3Jar2e_sJO4jSs_a2YRLqNfuKTJz0lqKn6tW_al3m9cRgQ0O7A7wNFPkh48km-Ci8zIumHXdn2vSR_QNLMjQgiGNVFndUsYDhy6cNH9pY1oiZvkXh5YwBbggLQ3IUK0_QTQeYoEioBDkq3sP7e0yswxf28PLvtpW5rsZpFbVfqfwkHh8PWqCofj__P78e2kcKji5V4VDgiWejRoiYzpW9DGNMWF2zPlnKrpFMF18Sn_uvLHHQ-HPwEAAP__fltwow), which oversees the strait and has attacked shipping in it for months. Gulf neighbors urged both sides back to the negotiating table.
## Clancy Jury Deadlocked, Told to Keep Trying

name: Sr. Anne Elizabeth Eder
subject: They have no place to go
body:
If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.

| | | |
---
| |
---
| | | Dear Friend, "We have no place to go." That's what Sister Francois-Dorothee tells me the poor children of the impoverished town of Matjieskloof in South Africa keep telling her. The situation isn't good. The children of Matjieskloof always had a hard life. It's a small town where most of the homes are made of tin siding and indoor plumbing is non-existent. But now things have gotten so much worse. At the start of this past year, schools in South Africa were still shut down and the kids literally had no place to go. With no air conditioning, internet, or even much space in their homes, staying inside hasn't been an option in the sweltering African heat. **So kids have taken to playing in the small garbage dumps that litter the town. ** And those are the kids that haven't tragically fallen prey to alcohol, drugs, and other horrible things that the gangs of a nearby city peddle them. No one is watching these children and they have nowhere to go. [That's why the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales want to give those children a place of their own. And it's why I'm asking today if you'll help. ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc-O2yAQxp8G34gw-O_Bh1QJVdVNW2VX2yMaYEjYYmMBTtW3rxI1D9Drp9_MaH7fz5M6gQ9-uXyDGadUnEpZlSv-ucINl7gGMFjiJSrOeEfZSBlXYIq_oWqgspM1FmpT4VT3wyCalommuk68R9Mg1CP0huPAbOvc0Fvb67F1vegqP933sZHxmgkmxK4G4bAWYuyAdUxb0jAImMou4brp4A0sBfIvF5PBnYlzFaZrKWsmYk-4JFxmNFvCHSxoY7kThMuoAxSk2eeCKdPoaC7UJViMz9QizRAwEy5X6EdjuG5pZxugTfsxf5iBgnaW2rFGrU2jh3ogQm5lVjluySARh_PxnfDuHs1o_TYTcTie9l9e_oUG5hX8ZSHi8Ph2ELX6dPisvr_KV3U-vqsHrE5fXyT9safnN_kcjEvBpdwvvEn6NFWlya6_fQg-dz1p2GUGHx4uyn8Xd5v43wAAAP__7IWjhA) **Sister Francois-Dorothee — who leads our mission in Matjieskloof — has cleared off some land** **and started building an outdoor community center (with the help of some older children)... ** **...so kids have a safe place to be kids.** The children in town are very excited and have been using their crayons to show how they would like this space to look. I wish you could see the beaming smiles on these children imagining what it would be like to have a place to play that isn't a garbage dump. But the Oblate Sisters would like this space to be so much more. We want this to be a place where children can be taught daily. Fed daily. And where our Sisters can pray with them daily. However, with just the Sisters and children themselves working on this center, progress has been moving far too slow. These children can't wait years. They're losing their childhoods right now. Unfortunately, it's not going to be cheap to hire professionals who can build quickly. And our Sisters in Matjieskloof just don't have that kind of money. **Which is why Sister Francois-Dorothee has asked me to reach out to people like you who might be able to help.** My name is Sister Anne Elizabeth Eder and I'm the North American Delegate for the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales. Saint Leonie Aviat founded the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales in 1866 after visiting a factory and seeing the harsh conditions that so many were working under. She knew that these least privileged in society especially needed to hear the words of Christ. Our mission in Matjieskloof was founded under her direction in 1885. **[And in our 138 years in Matjieskloof, I'm not sure if the children there have ever needed our help more than now. ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc-O2yAQxp8G34gw-O_Bh1QJVdVNW2VX2yMaYEjYYmMBTtW3rxI1D9Drp9_MaH7fz5M6gQ9-uXyDGadUnEpZlSv-ucINl7gGMFjiJSrOeEfZSBlXYIq_oWqgspM1FmpT4VT3wyCalommuk68R9Mg1CP0huPAbOvc0Fvb67F1vegqP933sZHxmgkmxK4G4bAWYuyAdUxb0jAImMou4brp4A0sBfIvF5PBnYlzFaZrKWsmYk-4JFxmNFvCHSxoY7kThMuoAxSk2eeCKdPoaC7UJViMz9QizRAwEy5X6EdjuG5pZxugTfsxf5iBgnaW2rFGrU2jh3ogQm5lVjluySARh_PxnfDuHs1o_TYTcTie9l9e_oUG5hX8ZSHi8Ph2ELX6dPisvr_KV3U-vqsHrE5fXyT9safnN_kcjEvBpdwvvEn6NFWlya6_fQg-dz1p2GUGHx4uyn8Xd5v43wAAAP__7IWjhA)**I know you're miles and miles away from these children, but today you can have a big impact on their lives. Specifically, I am asking you to do two things:
---
| | | **1\. Will you pray for the children of Matjieskloof?** Please pray they find the strength to make it through the hardships of their daily lives. **2\. Will you send a one-time gift of $25** so we can finish building the urgently needed outdoor community center for the children of Matjieskloof — so our Oblate Sisters can continue to feed, educate, and pray with them?
---
| | | [ **DONATE ** ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc-O2yAQxp8G34gw-O_Bh1QJVdVNW2VX2yMaYEjYYmMBTtW3rxI1D9Drp9_MaH7fz5M6gQ9-uXyDGadUnEpZlSv-ucINl7gGMFjiJSrOeEfZSBlXYIq_oWqgspM1FmpT4VT3wyCalommuk68R9Mg1CP0huPAbOvc0Fvb67F1vegqP933sZHxmgkmxK4G4bAWYuyAdUxb0jAImMou4brp4A0sBfIvF5PBnYlzFaZrKWsmYk-4JFxmNFvCHSxoY7kThMuoAxSk2eeCKdPoaC7UJViMz9QizRAwEy5X6EdjuG5pZxugTfsxf5iBgnaW2rFGrU2jh3ogQm5lVjluySARh_PxnfDuHs1o_TYTcTie9l9e_oUG5hX8ZSHi8Ph2ELX6dPisvr_KV3U-vqsHrE5fXyT9safnN_kcjEvBpdwvvEn6NFWlya6_fQg-dz1p2GUGHx4uyn8Xd5v43wAAAP__7IWjhA)
---
| | | I understand that it might not be easy to spare much, especially right now. I would never want you to give money that you truly need for your own family. But I know we often spend $25 without really thinking about it on things we truly don't need. These children need you. [**That's why if you can afford to send a larger amount — say $35, $50, or even $100 — it would be most appreciated.** ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc-O2yAQxp8G34gw-O_Bh1QJVdVNW2VX2yMaYEjYYmMBTtW3rxI1D9Drp9_MaH7fz5M6gQ9-uXyDGadUnEpZlSv-ucINl7gGMFjiJSrOeEfZSBlXYIq_oWqgspM1FmpT4VT3wyCalommuk68R9Mg1CP0huPAbOvc0Fvb67F1vegqP933sZHxmgkmxK4G4bAWYuyAdUxb0jAImMou4brp4A0sBfIvF5PBnYlzFaZrKWsmYk-4JFxmNFvCHSxoY7kThMuoAxSk2eeCKdPoaC7UJViMz9QizRAwEy5X6EdjuG5pZxugTfsxf5iBgnaW2rFGrU2jh3ogQm5lVjluySARh_PxnfDuHs1o_TYTcTie9l9e_oUG5hX8ZSHi8Ph2ELX6dPisvr_KV3U-vqsHrE5fXyT9safnN_kcjEvBpdwvvEn6NFWlya6_fQg-dz1p2GUGHx4uyn8Xd5v43wAAAP__7IWjhA)Please don't forget the words of our Savior: _"Whatever you did for one of these least brothers of mine, you did for me."_ So if you've been particularly blessed and can give a larger amount, I hope you'll consider gifts of $250, $500, $1,000, or even $10,000. But any gift will help us. Whether you give $25 or $1,000, I thank you for helping shine light into the lives of these children. You'll be in my prayers.
---
| | | God Bless,
---
| | |
---
| | **Sister Anne Elizabeth Eder** Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales
---
| | | [ **DONATE ** ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc-O2yAQxp8G34gw-O_Bh1QJVdVNW2VX2yMaYEjYYmMBTtW3rxI1D9Drp9_MaH7fz5M6gQ9-uXyDGadUnEpZlSv-ucINl7gGMFjiJSrOeEfZSBlXYIq_oWqgspM1FmpT4VT3wyCalommuk68R9Mg1CP0huPAbOvc0Fvb67F1vegqP933sZHxmgkmxK4G4bAWYuyAdUxb0jAImMou4brp4A0sBfIvF5PBnYlzFaZrKWsmYk-4JFxmNFvCHSxoY7kThMuoAxSk2eeCKdPoaC7UJViMz9QizRAwEy5X6EdjuG5pZxugTfsxf5iBgnaW2rFGrU2jh3ogQm5lVjluySARh_PxnfDuHs1o_TYTcTie9l9e_oUG5hX8ZSHi8Ph2ELX6dPisvr_KV3U-vqsHrE5fXyT9safnN_kcjEvBpdwvvEn6NFWlya6_fQg-dz1p2GUGHx4uyn8Xd5v43wAAAP__7IWjhA)
---
| | | **P.S.** The children of Matjieskloof in South Africa have no place to go. They're literally playing in garbage dumps. We need to give them a safe place where they can be kids. **Please make a one-time contribution of $25 or more to help these children during this critical time.**
---
| | | God bless you for your generosity. I will be praying for you.

## Edouard Comes Ashore, Knocks Out Power
Tropical Storm Edouard came ashore near Johnson Bayou, Louisiana, [at 2:20 p.m. Tuesday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAQhp8GNqPzYQIePHTJlq4dkYOP2JLByL4E2qeviPoGXU-n7_-__-s23myIYX182oUMH3MaV9pLJGbKI7n0tNlFu7oiVbdsaf0JZfI0IuBFgBaAo504vGhUtnbmDk7Lmozsh6FVPYCsvcG2Q4eDdqAUadDTjIS9GrRru2EGWQdz4kADSgmt1A31Wtn5Lu-9VNi5S6WAXOCUG_bEdNgyx-_0otxMaamj8cxbqdqPCq8VXvd9b-Z0qFPkfDhPZNlTrvDKOW1hslEUTnkRf4bCp2fhtIo3XJx16mzctocYQ7n0lYLHYkN85_F_d3oZ_A0AAP__qcF9HQ) with 60 mph winds, then pushed heavy rain into Southeast Texas. **The Senate GOP’s top super PAC went live with false attack ads against me, and they are now spending more in North Carolina than anywhere else on the map.**

name: Power the Polls
subject: Don’t miss your chance to be a poll worker this election
body:
| Deadlines are coming up, start your application today _You’re getting this message from[ _Power the Polls_](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4508?t=1&akid=9168%2E934366%2EAbRil5) because you signed up to learn about serving as a poll worker. If you no longer wish to hear from us, [_please unsubscribe here_](https://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=9168.934366.AbRil5&t=2&akid=9168%2E934366%2EAbRil5). Marking emails as spam can affect our ability to reach others with important information. _
# [](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/42?t=3&akid=9168%2E934366%2EAbRil5)
Hey Peter— Today is our September Recruitment Day of Action! Folks around the country are urging their communities to work the polls this fall – early vote is right around the corner and many states still need people to fill critical positions at polling places. Without enough poll workers, polling places may close and voters may not get the assistance they need. [**All you need to do is enter your ZIP code to get the application and information for your community. Applying only takes a few minutes, after that your local elections officials will be in touch with updates on training and next steps.**](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/446?t=4&akid=9168%2E934366%2EAbRil5) As a reminder, here’s what you can expect:
1. **Poll workers help check in voters** , set up and close polling places, and make sure voting sites run smoothly during Early Vote and on Election Day. Depending on your state, you might be called an "election worker" or "election judge" – but the role is the same.
2. **Most assignments are one day** – Election Day itself. Most locations also ask for a few hours of training beforehand, usually on a weekend or evening. If you have time to serve more, then you might be a good fit for running an early voting site, these assignments generally last a week or two.
3. **You get paid** in most states! Most poll workers earn between $100–$300 for the day.

[Start your official application](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4932?t=5&akid=9168%2E934366%2EAbRil5) Thanks - see you at the polls, The Power the Polls Team P.S. We want to send you the most useful information. **[Can you take two minutes to update us on your application status?](https://act.powerthepolls.org/survey/2026_poll_worker_status_survey/?t=6&akid=9168%2E934366%2EAbRil5)**
---
* * *
This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com). You received this message because you are subscribed to Power the Polls' mailing list. [Click here to unsubscribe.](https://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?ak_proof=1&akid=9168.934366.AbRil5&t=7&akid=9168%2E934366%2EAbRil5) If you have any questions, please contact us at [info@powerthepolls.org](mailto:info@powerthepolls.org) and a member of our team will be in touch.

Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is now FREE on DVD.

In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the president of Hillsdale College, Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

You'll explore these relationships in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

body:
Credibility is everything in international relations
---
| | | | | |
---
| |
#### Teichert in the Trenches - September 2026
Welcome to this month’s installment of Teichert in the Trenches, a monthly newsletter highlighting a snippet of my attempts to maximize my impact on people and our great nation and to develop the leaders our nation needs! ** _Teichert in the News_**
---
It continues to be mostly about Iran, though I’ve added a few different elements of the situation that provide a broad perspective.
---
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBmP64SPACXkt7Xr7g/1cVLhlvgYkcd)
---
Credibility is everything in international relations, and ours is waning. I attributed the quote “Stop or I’ll yell stop again” to Mall Cop, but it was originally coined by Robin Williams. (John Roberts, Fox News, August 4).
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13EXv1dZJgdaBrW9hw/hQ8TP7prWFdc)
---
A few quick thoughts in a short interview about the situations in Iran and Ukraine – my first time on with Staurt (Stuart Varney, Fox Business, August 5).
| [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG7uggjyojTAjPUbUSIC/UMgK1inPFhe6)
---
Real concerns about the diminished weapons stockpiles based on the combat operations during the last six months in the Middle East (Batya Ungar-Sargon, NewsNation, August 6).
| [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGEm8pYvztcepEnLSksS/tfTuLqjGaBmJ)
---
I was on with Blake Burman the night before the beginning of the war six months ago. This interview was a good opportunity to reflect on successes and on-going concerns based on the results of the last six months. And this is the last interview I did before shaving my vacation beard (NewsNation, August 27).
| [ The Senate Stalls
Vacation Time](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGLdayNtB3m8v465R3Si/yC-8JU6iCh8X)
---
| | | 🇺🇲 🇮🇷 The Teichert Strategy – achieving our strategic objectives in Iran. I didn’t name it this, but my friends at Real Clear Politics did (August 6).

📺 📻 I frequently post shorter-form interviews, but I’m honored to be a regular guest on the incredible RCP show which provides a more thorough discussion about the national security topics of the day.

🎥 Please check out the link above for their show from a couple of weeks ago. My segment starts at ~ 36:30.

💥 As someone who does a lot of traditional television and radio interviews, I fully realize that a media landscape that emphasizes short-form responses to difficult topics is part of the problem. | | | ✈️ A memorial to remember the heroes of a B-24 named Hot Stuff!

🇮🇸 Along the road from Keflavik Airport to Reykjavik is a monument worth considering. It’s been moved to this more convenient location since I was there for its launch in 2018 because lava flows came within 50 yards of its original location (the pictured sign that only makes sense in the land of fire and ice).

🤔 The world knows all about the B-17 named the Memphis Belle. But as with most of history, there’s more to the story.

🫡 The 8th Air Force Bomber crews played a heroic and historical role in the European Theater of Operations during World War II. The Memphis Belle crew was undoubtedly part of the heroic legacy of the conflict. Yet, the B-24 Liberator nicknamed Hot Stuff completed 25 missions well before the Memphis Belle. In fact, two weeks before the Memphis Belle completed its 25th mission, Hot Stuff was already on its way back to the United States to celebrate their milestone. Unfortunately, on May 3, 1943, they crashed in the rugged mountains of Iceland enroute to a planned refueling stop. As a result, they did not return to the United States, and the Memphis Belle instead became the poster child for bomber success and bravery.

🇺🇲 On that flight on that day, Lieutenant General Frank Andrews had joined the flight crew. He was the Commanding General of the European Theater of Operations at the time, and historical documents indicate that he was returning to Washington DC to receive his fourth star and possibly be recognized as the Supreme Allied Commander. His death on that day left a void that was ultimately filled by General Eisenhower.

In the fall of 2016, I had recently taken the helm as the commander of Joint Base Andrews. Noah was starting 3rd Grade.
As I was looking through the folder my front office staff gave me before leaving at the end of each day, Noah’s eyes lit up. He briefly walked away and came back with a red folder of his own.
The words “Take Home Folder” were emblazoned on the front of both. Affixed to the fronts were our names and our positions. And they were each filled with items that we should pay attention to that evening.
It’s proof that some things never change ... whether you are a 3rd grader or the commander of America’s Airfield.
Rejoin Opportunities
This coming month, I will be at the following events, and it would be great to see you there:

* Speaking in the morning service at Maranatha Baptist Church for the 25th anniversary of 9/11 (Jacksonville, NC, September 13).
* Officiating the retirement of Lt Col Devin “Sparky” Long (Pentagon, September 17).
* Speaking on a panel at the Defense TechConnect Innovation Summit & Expo (National Harbor, MD, September 23).
* Speaking and doing a book signing for the Edwards AFB Civ-Mil Group (Lancaster, CA, September 27).
* Speaking at Lancaster Baptist Church and West Coast Baptist College as a part of the Spiritual Leadership Conference & 40th Anniversary (Lancaster, CA, September 28 & 29).

| | **_Meet Russell:_** Born and raised in Surfside Beach, SC, Congressman Russell Fry is the proud and homegrown Representative for South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District. Growing up in a cinder block home with no heating or air conditioning, Russell learned at an early age that hard work and perseverance pave the only true path to the American Dream. He watched his parents work day in and day out to make ends meet. And the values they instilled in him during his upbringing led Russell to self-fund both his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina, and later his law studies at the Charleston School of Law. At Charleston, Russell served as the President of the Student Bar Association and even helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation. He went on to practice law in the Grand Strand area for over a decade before entering the political arena to serve in the South Carolina House of Representatives for State House District 106 (Horry County). During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. name: Sr. Anne Elizabeth Eder
subject: No one is watching these children
body:
The situation isn't good.

| | | |
---
| |
---
| | | Dear Friend, "We have no place to go." That's what Sister Francois-Dorothee tells me the poor children of the impoverished town of Matjieskloof in South Africa keep telling her. The situation isn't good. The children of Matjieskloof always had a hard life. It's a small town where most of the homes are made of tin siding and indoor plumbing is non-existent. But now things have gotten so much worse. At the start of this past year, schools in South Africa were still shut down and the kids literally had no place to go. With no air conditioning, internet, or even much space in their homes, staying inside hasn't been an option in the sweltering African heat. **So kids have taken to playing in the small garbage dumps that litter the town. ** And those are the kids that haven't tragically fallen prey to alcohol, drugs, and other horrible things that the gangs of a nearby city peddle them. No one is watching these children and they have nowhere to go. [That's why the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales want to give those children a place of their own. And it's why I'm asking today if you'll help. ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcFunDAQhp_G3LyyjQFz4LAVS1Q126wSKT1aY3sAR2Aj7E1evyJtXiDXT_-MZr7_z1VfwS8-TL9hxW6K26b3pEOMAX36gGxnH6Y8Y0I7-8VpwURNWUuZ0GCzf0ctoXCdhFrWdV1gxxulykoo3hRz5xirxkpYI7hDdNCOSlleGTPatm4cFr47FrKWCS4k49WpaRrRMIZylJJjaYhk6HyO--m4bcfkHYbsYTnZuBZLN-e8JVKeiRiIGBLa-44nCOhiPhJEDNEskJEmnzLuicaRpkzHHYL1iTqkCRZMRAwbNK21wlS0dhKorN7WN6somNFR13I0xkqjuCLlcM-rTvG-WyRl_3x5JaI-0IrO31dS9pfr-efjf2hh3cBPgZT956uq5PpH_6CfXoYX_Xx51Z9hff31ONDbmT483W5fkzFkDJmU_QHpl6hi79z24ZfFp7ohkk0r-H828nf7e-_E3wAAAP__9KGoWw) **Sister Francois-Dorothee — who leads our mission in Matjieskloof — has cleared off some land** **and started building an outdoor community center (with the help of some older children)... ** **...so kids have a safe place to be kids.** The children in town are very excited and have been using their crayons to show how they would like this space to look. I wish you could see the beaming smiles on these children imagining what it would be like to have a place to play that isn't a garbage dump. But the Oblate Sisters would like this space to be so much more. We want this to be a place where children can be taught daily. Fed daily. And where our Sisters can pray with them daily. However, with just the Sisters and children themselves working on this center, progress has been moving far too slow. These children can't wait years. They're losing their childhoods right now. Unfortunately, it's not going to be cheap to hire professionals who can build quickly. And our Sisters in Matjieskloof just don't have that kind of money. **Which is why Sister Francois-Dorothee has asked me to reach out to people like you who might be able to help.** My name is Sister Anne Elizabeth Eder and I'm the North American Delegate for the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales. Saint Leonie Aviat founded the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales in 1866 after visiting a factory and seeing the harsh conditions that so many were working under. She knew that these least privileged in society especially needed to hear the words of Christ. Our mission in Matjieskloof was founded under her direction in 1885. **[And in our 138 years in Matjieskloof, I'm not sure if the children there have ever needed our help more than now. ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcFunDAQhp_G3LyyjQFz4LAVS1Q126wSKT1aY3sAR2Aj7E1evyJtXiDXT_-MZr7_z1VfwS8-TL9hxW6K26b3pEOMAX36gGxnH6Y8Y0I7-8VpwURNWUuZ0GCzf0ctoXCdhFrWdV1gxxulykoo3hRz5xirxkpYI7hDdNCOSlleGTPatm4cFr47FrKWCS4k49WpaRrRMIZylJJjaYhk6HyO--m4bcfkHYbsYTnZuBZLN-e8JVKeiRiIGBLa-44nCOhiPhJEDNEskJEmnzLuicaRpkzHHYL1iTqkCRZMRAwbNK21wlS0dhKorN7WN6somNFR13I0xkqjuCLlcM-rTvG-WyRl_3x5JaI-0IrO31dS9pfr-efjf2hh3cBPgZT956uq5PpH_6CfXoYX_Xx51Z9hff31ONDbmT483W5fkzFkDJmU_QHpl6hi79z24ZfFp7ohkk0r-H828nf7e-_E3wAAAP__9KGoWw)**I know you're miles and miles away from these children, but today you can have a big impact on their lives. Specifically, I am asking you to do two things:
---
| | | **1\. Will you pray for the children of Matjieskloof?** Please pray they find the strength to make it through the hardships of their daily lives. **2\. Will you send a one-time gift of $25** so we can finish building the urgently needed outdoor community center for the children of Matjieskloof — so our Oblate Sisters can continue to feed, educate, and pray with them?
---
| | | [ **DONATE ** ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcFunDAQhp_G3LyyjQFz4LAVS1Q126wSKT1aY3sAR2Aj7E1evyJtXiDXT_-MZr7_z1VfwS8-TL9hxW6K26b3pEOMAX36gGxnH6Y8Y0I7-8VpwURNWUuZ0GCzf0ctoXCdhFrWdV1gxxulykoo3hRz5xirxkpYI7hDdNCOSlleGTPatm4cFr47FrKWCS4k49WpaRrRMIZylJJjaYhk6HyO--m4bcfkHYbsYTnZuBZLN-e8JVKeiRiIGBLa-44nCOhiPhJEDNEskJEmnzLuicaRpkzHHYL1iTqkCRZMRAwbNK21wlS0dhKorN7WN6somNFR13I0xkqjuCLlcM-rTvG-WyRl_3x5JaI-0IrO31dS9pfr-efjf2hh3cBPgZT956uq5PpH_6CfXoYX_Xx51Z9hff31ONDbmT483W5fkzFkDJmU_QHpl6hi79z24ZfFp7ohkk0r-H828nf7e-_E3wAAAP__9KGoWw)
---
| | | I understand that it might not be easy to spare much, especially right now. I would never want you to give money that you truly need for your own family. But I know we often spend $25 without really thinking about it on things we truly don't need. These children need you. [**That's why if you can afford to send a larger amount — say $35, $50, or even $100 — it would be most appreciated.** ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcFunDAQhp_G3LyyjQFz4LAVS1Q126wSKT1aY3sAR2Aj7E1evyJtXiDXT_-MZr7_z1VfwS8-TL9hxW6K26b3pEOMAX36gGxnH6Y8Y0I7-8VpwURNWUuZ0GCzf0ctoXCdhFrWdV1gxxulykoo3hRz5xirxkpYI7hDdNCOSlleGTPatm4cFr47FrKWCS4k49WpaRrRMIZylJJjaYhk6HyO--m4bcfkHYbsYTnZuBZLN-e8JVKeiRiIGBLa-44nCOhiPhJEDNEskJEmnzLuicaRpkzHHYL1iTqkCRZMRAwbNK21wlS0dhKorN7WN6somNFR13I0xkqjuCLlcM-rTvG-WyRl_3x5JaI-0IrO31dS9pfr-efjf2hh3cBPgZT956uq5PpH_6CfXoYX_Xx51Z9hff31ONDbmT483W5fkzFkDJmU_QHpl6hi79z24ZfFp7ohkk0r-H828nf7e-_E3wAAAP__9KGoWw)Please don't forget the words of our Savior: _"Whatever you did for one of these least brothers of mine, you did for me."_ So if you've been particularly blessed and can give a larger amount, I hope you'll consider gifts of $250, $500, $1,000, or even $10,000. But any gift will help us. Whether you give $25 or $1,000, I thank you for helping shine light into the lives of these children. You'll be in my prayers.
---
| | | God Bless,
---
| | |
---
| | **Sister Anne Elizabeth Eder** Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales

body:

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
** September 2, 2026**Ohio-01 Republican Eric Conroy Launches First Ad Ahead of the General Election****CINCINNATI, OH** — Republican candidate for Congress, Eric Conroy launches his first ad ahead of the general election in November. “[Service Before Self](https://us.list-manage.com/AK5bua2d4u_?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566)” highlights Eric Conroy’s grandfather’s service in WWII, leading him to want to live a life of service. The ad shows Conroy’s journey from the Air Force Academy, before serving for seven years in the Air Force and joining the CIA, spending another seven years protecting the American people. _“We are on the air out of the gate, setting the stage for the choice in this election: I’ve always strived to serve others and our country. Career politician Greg Landsman serves himself by enriching himself through insider stock trading and filling his campaign coffers with special interest money and fat checks from far-left billionaires in California and New York. Landsman helps himself and the radical left, and the people of Cincinnati always come last. It’s time for change. My campaign is focused on service and bringing people together for a lower cost of living, good jobs, safe streets, and excellent schools.”_ Conroy said. “[Service Before Self](https://us.list-manage.com/irzb7LaYon2?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566)”**Transcript:** My grandfather served in World War II. He taught me the importance of “service before self”. I graduated from the Air Force Academy, led special operations forces and became a CIA case officer. I served under Republican and Democratic presidents. I could bring both parties together and find common ground. Stopping corruption, lowering your costs, and making your healthcare more affordable. It starts with “service before self”. I’m Eric Conroy and I approve this message, because you deserve better.
"Service Before Self" is now airing across the district on broadcast tv, cable and streaming as part of a $550,000 initial ad buy. **###**

This is probably our biggest win yet.
As the AG, I'm proud of this one - but as a dad to three kids, I'm excited. This is what I've wanted as a parent, long before becoming AG.
Protecting kids, empowering parents. That was the goal, and this is a historic step.
Here's the story.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e0a93b58-f3dd-4ade-957c-16a574248bc2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Press conference announcing Meta settlement
* * *
Basically, we said to Meta (the owner of Facebook and Instagram), "Hey, we think you built your apps to addict children, then misled parents about it, and it did a lot of harm to a whole generation of young people."
And Meta basically said, "Nope, we'd never do that."
So we did an investigation and uncovered all these internal documents where they admitted to it. They talked openly about how "our product exploits weaknesses in human psychology" and "Instagram is a drug" and "we're basically pushers." They talked about targeting kids by triggering dopamine hits and how profitable that was - even calling the targeting of teens the "overall company goal" and "critical to the success of Instagram."
Then we showed them this evidence and said, "Look, we got you, time to change your ways."
And Meta said, "Nope, take us to court."
So we did. And the trial started a couple weeks ago.
But several months ago, Meta said they were open to settling. So negotiations began.
We felt confident we would win at trial, so we were only interested in a settlement if it gave us _more than we would get from the court._
We knew we could get a ton of money from the court, but we wouldn't get the most valuable thing we really wanted: a new set of real protections for kids.
We wouldn't get that from the court because that's not how courts typically work. Judges have a hard time crafting detailed limitations on tech companies. It's much easier to just punish a company with a gigantic fine rather than specifying dozens of new software features for it to adopt.
And those new software features were what we really wanted. That's how you protect kids and empower parents, which was our real goal.
So those new features became the focus of our negotiation - not the money.
And naturally, we started very far apart.
Meta's main concern was that any new child safety features they agreed to would put them at a competitive disadvantage against Youtube, Tiktok, and Snapchat.
The big break came when they agreed to adopt those provisions unilaterally, without insisting that those other platforms join them.
However, we all agreed it would be best to get these features on all social media platforms, so we wrote the agreement in a way to help that happen.
In other words, this is a big win, but it's designed to set up some even bigger wins by encouraging wider adoption of these new safeguards.
So, yes, this is a huge amount of money for NC. Meta will pay our state a minimum of $451 million and a maximum of $645 million. That makes it one of the largest settlements in state history. By law, those funds will go to the state, and discussions have already begun about how to best use those funds to address the harm that was caused, i.e., youth mental health and wellbeing.
But the money is secondary. The bigger deal is a new set of default settings for every Meta user under 18, which can only be changed with parental approval. Some of them are:
* Two-hour daily limit. (Currently, nearly 40% of teens are using social media for more than five hours per day.)
* No access to feeds from midnight to 6am, so kids can sleep.
* Push notifications disabled during school hours, for fewer distractions during school.
* Beauty filters that mimic cosmetic surgery by changing the face of your face and body are disabled.
* Like counts are hidden, so every post isn't a public ranking in front of your peer group.
* After a long scroll, Meta has to prompt kids to take a break.
* An independent auditor gets access to Meta's internal information and reports on whether the company is actually complying.

Keep in mind, _we did this because Congress didn 't._
For years, we've all known what was happening to kids on social media was bad. But Congress hasn't been able to get reform across the goal line, so it fell to AGs to figure this out.
And it was a huge, bipartisan group. My thanks to AGs in both parties who worked on this.
Here's what happens next:
Over the next few months, these new default settings will start rolling out.
Kids will hit their limits and go to their parents to ask for more time (as mine do, all the time).
And then those parents will have a conversation with their kids about what's right for them. Maybe the time limit goes up. Maybe down. The point is that parents will be part of that decision in a way they aren't now.
This settlement will prompt _millions_ of those conversations, and that's a big step in the right direction.
Best,
Jeff

Buffett Said This Was “Playing With Fire”

Warren Buffett once called it the best single measure of stock-market valuation.

When the value of the market approaches **200% of the economy** , he warned that investors are “playing with fire.”

Today, that indicator is sitting near **239%** — around its highest level ever recorded.

That does not tell us exactly when stocks will correct.

But according to gold analyst Garrett Goggin, similar periods of extreme valuation have historically created powerful opportunities in gold.

He has identified three profitable junior miners trading at deep discounts to the estimated value of their gold assets.

And cash-rich mining giants may already be looking for their next acquisition targets.

These three stocks could potentially benefit twice:

First from the gold bull market...

Then from a possible takeover premium.

I am writing to ask you to dig deep and contribute what you can to Dr. Jermaine Johnson's campaign for Governor of South Carolina.
While national Senate candidates get all the attention and donations, this is one of the great overlooked races in the country this cycle.
I know... I know... some of you may be thinking: “Gavin Newsom, what makes you think Democrats have a chance to flip South Carolina's governor's race?”
Let me start with this. During the last Trump midterm election, the Democratic candidate for Governor of South Carolina lost by single digits.
Add to that the fact that he was woefully underfunded and out-raised dramatically by his opponent.
Now consider that the environment is even better for Democrats this cycle, and if we can get our Democratic nominee the resources he needs to win we could just pull off one of the most shocking results of the November election.
I've seen polling that shows this is a 2 point race. So I wanted to reach out to share the audacious thought that if we chip in what we can, we can absolutely win this race. Imagine watching THAT on election night.
But Dr. Jermaine Johnson needs those of us who want to see sweeping Democratic victories to help him -- so before I get to South Carolina this week, I am asking:
